qe: When the mutinous sepoys fled from Dinapore in July 1857, why was the pursuit not continued beyond the cantonments?
qh: जुलाई 1857 में विद्रोही सिपाहियों के दानापुर से भाग जाने पर उनका पीछा छावनी से आगे क्यों नहीं किया गया?
oe: Because the sepoys had already crossed the Sone
Because a river blocked the way
Because the General was absent and nobody would take responsibility
Because the order came from Calcutta to stop
oh: क्योंकि सिपाही सोन पार कर चुके थे
क्योंकि रास्ते में नदी आ गई
क्योंकि जनरल मौजूद नहीं था और किसी ने जिम्मेदारी लेना स्वीकार नहीं किया
क्योंकि कलकत्ता से रुक जाने का आदेश आ गया
e: July 1857 me Dinapore ki chhawni me sipahiyon ne apne kamandar ka aadesh maanne se inkar kar diya tatha unke hi afsaron par goli chalayi. Angreji (European) sipahi turant mauke par pahunch gaye tatha vidrohi sipahi bhaag khade hue. Lekin unka peechha chhawni se aage nahi kiya gaya; iska karan yah tha ki General us samay maujood nahi tha tatha kisi afsar ne apne aap par zimmedari lena theek nahi samjha. Isi ka parinaam yah hua ki vidrohi sipahiyon ka bada hissa apne hathiyar tatha saamaan le kar Sone nadi paar kar gaya tatha Arrah ke paas Kunwar Singh ke saath ja mila, jisse vidroh ko aur bal mila. Aise ghatnakram se pata chalta hai ki agreji sena ki command me deri tatha zimmedari lene se jhijhak vidroh ko badhane ka bada karan bani. Exam point: July 1857 me Dinapore se bhage vidrohi sipahiyon ka peechha chhawni se aage nahi hua kyunki General maujood nahi tha tatha koi zimmedari lene ko taiyar nahi tha; isi kaaran vidrohi Sone nadi paar kar Arrah ke paas Kunwar Singh ke saath mil gaye.

qe: Four hundred men of which British regiment left Dinapore by steamer on 29 July 1857 for Arrah?
qh: 29 जुलाई 1857 को दानापुर से आरा की ओर स्टीमर से किस ब्रिटिश रेजिमेंट के चार सौ सैनिक रवाना हुए?
e: July 1857 me Dinapore ki chhawni se vidrohi sipahiyon ke bhaagne ke baad Arrah ke paas Kunwar Singh ke saath mile vidrohiyon ka saamna karne ke liye ek abhiyan bheja gaya. 29 July 1857 ko 10th Foot regiment ke chaar sau sipahi Dinapore se steamer par rawana hue. Yah abhiyan bahut buri tarah chalaya gaya; sipahiyon ko raat ke saat baje utara gaya tatha safed garmi ki vardi me andhere me Chapra Ghat road se Arrah ki taraf badhaya gaya. Aadhi raat ko yah toli ghairiyon ke ghaat me phans gayi tatha subah unhe wapas lautna pada; aadhe se zyada sainik peeche reh gaye. Aisi ghatnaon ne dikhaya ki vidroh ke shuruaati mahino me angreji sena ke faisle kitne jaldbaazi tatha laaparwahi se liye ja rahe the. Exam point: 29 July 1857 ko 10th Foot ke chaar sau sipahi Dinapore se steamer par Arrah ke liye rawana hue tatha raat me Chapra Ghat road se chal kar Kunwar Singh ke vidrohiyon ke ghaat me phans gaye; is abhiyan me unhe bahut nuksan uthana pada.

qe: In the Arrah expedition of July 1857 the British troops were landed at 7 p.m. and marched in darkness by which road?
qh: जुलाई 1857 के आरा अभियान में ब्रिटिश सैनिकों को शाम सात बजे उतारा गया तथा अंधेरे में किस सड़क से चलाया गया?
e: Arrah ke abhiyan me 10th Foot ke chaar sau sipahiyon ko Dinapore se steamer par bheja gaya tha. 29 July 1857 ki shaam sat baje unhe utara gaya tatha andhere me safed garmi ki vardi me Chapra Ghat road se Arrah ki taraf badhaya gaya. Andhere me chalna tatha safed vardi dono hi unke liye haanikarak sabit hue, kyunki vidrohi unhe door se dekh sakte the. Aadhi raat ke aas-paas yah toli ghairiyon ke ghaat yaani ambuscade me phans gayi, jahan unhe bhaari nuksan hua; subah unhe wapas lautna pada. Is abhiyan ki asafalta ke kaaran Dinapore me angreji command ki karyapranali par bade sawal uth khade hue. Exam point: Arrah ke liye gaya 10th Foot ka dal shaam saat baje utar kar andhere me Chapra Ghat road se badha tatha ghairiyon ke ghaat me phans gaya; safed garmi ki vardi tatha andhera dono unke liye haanikarak rahe; asafalta ke baad angreji command ki aalochana hui.

qe: Of the four hundred men who went towards Arrah in July 1857, only about how many returned unwounded?
qh: जुलाई 1857 में आरा की ओर गए चार सौ सैनिकों में से लगभग कितने बिना घायल हुए लौट सके?
e: 29 July 1857 ko Dinapore se 10th Foot ke chaar sau sipahi steamer par Arrah ki taraf bheje gaye the. Sipahiyon ko shaam saat baje utara gaya tatha andhere me Chapra Ghat road se chalaya gaya; aadhi raat ko yah toli vidrohiyon ke ghaat me phans gayi. Subah jab unhe wapas lautna pada, to unka aadha se zyada hissa maidan me hi reh gaya tatha bache hue logon me se keval lagbhag pachas sipahi hi bina ghayal hue apni chhawni tak laut sake. Is vipatti ne Patna kshetra me angreji sarkar ki sthiti ko aur kamzor kiya, lekin aage chal kar Punjab se aayi sena tatha sthanik sipahiyon ki madad se vidroh ko dabaya gaya. Aisi asafalta dikhati hai ki jaldbaazi me liye gaye sena-faisle kitne bhaari pad sakte hain. Exam point: Arrah ke liye gaye chaar sau sipahiyon me se lagbhag pachas hi bina ghayal ho kar laute; aadhe se zyada sainik maidan me hi reh gaye; is asafalta se Patna kshetra me angreji sarkar ki sthiti kamzor hui.

qe: Which leader of the 1857 revolt did the mutineers from Dinapore join after crossing the Sone?
qh: सोन नदी पार करने के बाद दानापुर के विद्रोही सिपाही किस 1857 के विद्रोही नेता के साथ जा मिले?
e: July 1857 me Dinapore ki chhawni se vidrohi sipahi bhaage tatha Sone nadi paar kar Arrah ke paas pahunche, jahan woh Jagdishpur ke Kunwar Singh ke saath ja mile. Kunwar Singh bhojpur kshetra ke bade zamindar the tatha 80 saal ki umar me bhi unhone vidroh ka netritva kiya; unke saath aaye sepoys ne unhe apna supreme commander maan liya. Iske baad Patna kshetra me vidrohi toliyan thana todne tatha niji sampatti lootne lagi, tatha shaanti poori tarah 1858 ke shuru me ja kar bahal hui. Aise varnan dikhate hain ki 1857 ka vidroh Patna tatha Bhojpur kshetra ka sanyukt sangharsh ban gaya tha, jisme zamindar tatha sepoys dono shamil the. Exam point: Dinapore se bhage vidrohi Sone nadi paar kar Arrah ke paas Jagdishpur ke Kunwar Singh ke saath mil gaye tatha unhone unhe apna supreme commander maana; vidroh ke dauraan Patna jile me toliyan thana todti tatha lootpat karti rahin; shaanti 1858 ke shuru me bahal hui.

qe: In which period was order generally restored in the Patna district after the disturbances of 1857?
qh: 1857 की गड़बड़ियों के बाद पटना जिले में सामान्य व्यवस्था किस समय बहाल हुई?
e: Arrah ke abhiyan ki asafalta ke baad angreji sarkar ne Patna shahar me do sau British sipahi tatha do topen bhejin, taaki asantusht logon ko daraya ja sake tatha shahar me shaanti rahe. Is kadam ka asar yah hua ki shahar ke logon ne aage koi badi gadbadi nahi ki. Lekin poore jile me vidrohi toliyan saal bhar bhatakti rahin tatha thane todne tatha niji sampatti lootne ki ghatnayein hoti rahin. Is tarah jile me samanya vyavastha 1858 ke shuru me ja kar bahal ho paayi. Aise varnan se pata chalta hai ki vidroh ko dabane me jitna samay laga, usse zyada mushkil kshetra me bharosa tatha vyavastha wapas lane me aayi. Exam point: Arrah ki asafalta ke baad Patna shahar me do sau British sipahi tatha do topen bheji gayin; shahar me badi gadbadi nahi hui, lekin jile me vidrohi toliyan saal bhar sakriy rahin; jile me samanya vyavastha 1858 ke shuru me bahal hui.

qe: On 4 August 1857 which Commissioner of Patna was relieved of his post, a step much debated at the time?
qh: 4 अगस्त 1857 को पटना के किस कमिश्नर को उसके पद से हटा दिया गया, जिस पर उस समय बहस हुई?
e: 1857 me Patna kshetra me vidroh ko dabane ke liye Commissioner William Tayler ne bahut sakht kadam liye the; 18 June ko Maulaviyon ki giraftari tatha saptahon tak kadi karwaiyan unhi ki dekh-rekh me hui. Aisi sakht karwaiyon se shahar me vidroh ka jwala bhadakne se bach gaya, lekin 4 August 1857 ko unhe unke pad se hata diya gaya tatha unka charge doosre adhikari ko diya gaya. Is faisle par us samay tatha baad me bhi bahas hoti rahi; ek vichaar yah tha ki Tayler ne shuruaati khatre ko samay par rok diya, jabki doosra yah ki zarurat khatm hone ke baad bhi unki sakhti jaari rahi. Baad me Samuells ne charge sambhala tatha shahar me shaanti bahal rahi. Exam point: 4 August 1857 ko Patna ke Commissioner William Tayler ko pad se mukti di gayi; unhone vidroh ke shuruaati khatre ko sakht karwaiyon se rok diya tha; unke jaane ke baad Samuells ne charge sambhala; is faisle par kaafi bahas hui.

qe: After the failure of the Arrah expedition in July 1857, what did the Patna district witness during the rest of the year?
qh: आरा की आपदा के बाद शेष 1857 में पटना जिले में क्या देखने को मिला?
oe: A general uprising of the whole countryside
Stray bands of mutineers roaming the district, looting and destroying thanas
oh: दानापुर के पास एक और बड़ी लड़ाई
पूरे ग्रामीण क्षेत्र का सामान्य विद्रोह
भटकती विद्रोही टोलियाँ, जो थाने तोड़ती और लूटपाट करती रहीं
e: Arrah ke abhiyan me 10th Foot ke dal ko bhaari nuksan hua tatha sirf lagbhag pachas sipahi bina ghayal ho kar laute. Iske baad angreji sarkar ne Patna shahar me do sau sipahi tatha do topen bheji, jisse shahar ke asantusht logon ne koi badi gadbadi nahi ki; kintu jile ke anya hisson me haalat theek nahi thi. Saal ke shesh mahino me vidrohi toliyan gaon-gaon me bhatakti rahin, thane (police chowki) todti rahin tatha niji sampatti lootti rahin. Isi kaaran jile me samanya vyavastha 1858 ke shuru me ja kar bahal hui tatha prashasan ko kai mahine lage apna control wapas jamane me. Exam point: Arrah ki haar ke baad Patna shahar me sena bhej kar shaanti rakhi gayi, lekin jile me 1857 ke shesh mahino me vidrohi toliyan bhatakti rahin, thane todti rahin tatha lootpat karti rahin; samanya vyavastha 1858 ke shuru me bahal hui.
